A '''Gank''' [[Limb/Legends|backhanded]] the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Den Dhur]] on the streets of the [[City/Legends|city]]&ndash;[[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] when Dhur inadvertently jostled the [[Gank/Legends|Gank]] while the journalist was inebriated. The Gank's [[Unidentified Gank thug 2|partner]], a member of the same [[Species/Legends|species]], then threatened the journalist with a [[Vibroknife/Legends|vibroknife]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[I-5YQ]] arrived on the scene, however, and frightened the Ganks away.
